applies: a GavickPro Gavern (gk_*) quickstart: the same site module as the JA families, in the earliest position its layout renders. Gavern has no runtime colour variables: its compiled stylesheets read the slot once tokenized (a JoomlArt re-release), and the slot's own selector rules do the rest
specificity: Rules are prefixed :root×6 (0,6,0): above every template rule, below an element's own inline style.
genericNote: the slot writes no short token names (--bg, --accent…) here; everything reads --ds-c-*
readyNote: measured 11/10/2026 on quickstart/gavick-gk-spotlight/j6 1.0.0 with its stylesheets tokenized as 1.0.1 ships them (tasks/evidence/ds-contracts-gk-2026-10-11): 12/12, controls 0 differences, no text made less readable than the template's own under the four systems tried, 96%–100% of the page follows; the 1.0.1 build itself (restored from its zip) measured the same: 12/12 (its default look: 0 computed differences against 1.0.0, 39/39 pages; the pixels differ because three home modules list articles in random order). Spotlight's default style ships Gavern's "Recompile CSS" on, which compiles less/ over css/ on every request and would erase the tokenized sheets: 1.0.1 ships it off (gavernRecompileOff, one row of installation/sql), and the css/ it ships is byte for byte what its LESS compiled to on the stand. The three pastel grounds of its top bands are surfaces, so a dark system darkens them under its light text. The page colours follow only from 1.0.1 (~/tracy-bench-work/RELEASE-DS-GAVICK.sh, not yet uploaded); minVersion keeps 1.0.0 sites out (TEMPLATE_NEEDS_UPDATE)
baseNote: painted on the default home page (discover.mjs), then T3 less/variables*.less (colours and faces); border and muted measured as the most painted line / grey text in css/*.css (61 line colours, 112 text colours seen)

module.title: Tracy design system

nearNote: near variants the stylesheets paint, each in the role its property allows (tokenize.mjs --suggest --near 24): added as palettes, read by a person
paletteNote: the three pastel grounds of the home page top bands (#gkTop1 #FDFBF8, #gkTop2 #FDF8FA, #gkTop3 #F8F9FD) are surfaces: under a dark system they follow its surface, so the text that follows its foreground stays readable on them
